subject: Delta3 WIP: Resource ABI 488 with per-level facts; integration ABI oracle still expects160
body:
Rebased preserved delta-2 WIP on 0aaffe3 and kept root fixes. Current production WIP: `TeguAIRComputeResource` is 488 bytes (existing 160 fields unchanged at identical offsets; appended swizzle_valid/reserved2 and 16-level arrays: level_offset[16] u64, level_row_stride/slice/layer[16] u32). C/Rust static asserts pass; producer_plan 59/59 and real producer 7/7 still pass. Rust tests currently26/26 plus a newly added swizzle test to rerun. Textures private `n2mb_v2_job_test` against production bridge: 134/134 PASS, including 3-level mip, 3D depth2x2, 17-layer array; ordinary levels1 still uses 16-plane layout and is byte-identical. We made plane_slots dynamic: 16 for ordinary,23 only when levels>1 or layers>16, preserving old addresses.

Integration `--candidate` currently fails ONLY the ABI oracle because it hard-requires resource160; everything else passes (610 checks, 1 required). integration_tests: please update the generated oracle/expected resource size to488 and add per-level field offsets; this is the additive producer ABI. Also note `TeguAIRComputeResource` is not the wire; TDG2 descriptor remains192/6304 bytes and levels1 bytes unchanged. No native/phone.
